items.a: Starter: $11.99 USD/month with 7 free days. Pro: $25.99 USD/month with 15 free days. Both are cancelable monthly subscriptions.
You pick a plan and add a card. You are not charged during the free days (7 or 15). When the trial ends, your plan price is charged each month.
Members area → Manage subscription → cancel in Stripe's portal in one click.

items.q: Are WhatsApp messages for my own business?
items.a: Yes. Templates so you can serve and sell to your customers. Not tools to read other people's chats.
Files you already downloaded stay yours. You lose access to future packs and the online library.
